subject: Fighter/Black Belt/White Mage/Black Mage
text: A party of Fighter, Black Belt, White Mage, and Black Mage is weak to start with because the Fighter is the only strong attacker.

evidence.quote: Perhaps the most popular party beginners go for... it is a group that is weak to start with because the Fighter is the only strong attacker.

subject: Black Belt
text: The Black Belt becomes a better physical attacker after Level 10 and slowly gains defense through Absorb.

evidence.quote: The Black Belt is a pretty weak (defensively) Second character, but eventually will become a better physical attacker after Level 10 and slowly get decent defense (through the Absorb Oddity).

subject: Fighter/Black Belt/White Mage/Black Mage
text: Purchasing spells builds up expenses as the party reaches each new location.

evidence.quote: However, spells, spells, spells will build up your bills as you arrive at each new locale.

subject: Fast
text: The spell Fast remains useful for the Black Mage to cast on the Knight or Master.

evidence.quote: Fast will remain useful to use on the Knight and/or Master.

subject: Fighter
text: Buying Silver Swords early on for all four Fighters allows the party to hack through nearly anything for most or all of the game.

evidence.quote: If you buy Silver Swords for all four Fighters early on, then you can just hack through just about anything for most, if not all of the game.

subject: Fighter
text: Due to heavy armor, the Fighter's Evade is low, leaving them vulnerable to paralyzing undead monsters and Sorcerers.

evidence.quote: Due to the heavy armor of the Fighter, their Evade is low.  Prepare to get frustrated at places with undead monsters that paralyze and look out for Sorcerers too.

subject: Knight
text: Equipping an Aegis Shield and Dragon Armor provides protection comparable to a Ribbon on a Knight.

evidence.quote: You can however make it up with proper armor distribution (Aegis Shield + Dragon Armor is comparable to a Ribbon that the other three Knights might have equipped).

subject: Knight
text: The Cur2 spell is too weak to heal a near-dead character during late-game battles.

evidence.quote: Cur2 is too weak to attempt to heal a near-dead character in battle.

subject: Red Mage
text: Including a Red Mage makes money scarcer in the first half of the game due to purchasing spells with Gold.

evidence.quote: Would be really strong plus backup of black magic spells along with the occasional heal spell money will be more scarce through the first half with the Red Mage sucking up Gold for spells.

subject: Red Wizard
text: A party with three Knights and a Red Wizard cannot learn Level 8 spells.

evidence.quote: No Level 8 spells, and a lot of red sprites on the right side of the screen.

subject: Thief
text: The Thief cannot fight decently until obtaining the Dragon or Coral Swords.

evidence.quote: The Thief can't fight decently until after you get the Dragon/Coral Swords.

subject: Red Mage
text: The Red Mage cannot learn the Life spell until undergoing class promotion.

evidence.quote: Also the Red Mage cannot learn the Life spell until promotion, so good care should be taken to prevent deaths.
